Home.treatmentBody: Patients travel to the clinic from across Cyprus, the United Kingdom and Germany. Consultations and procedures take place in Nicosia, in Greek, English or German.

Contact.metaDescription: Contact Dr Paris Papakostas — ENT, nose and sinus surgery in Nicosia, Cyprus. Phone, WhatsApp, email and clinic location.
Contact.bookBody: Choose a time that suits you and arrange your first appointment online. Every treatment begins with an in-person consultation, where your options, recovery and any risks are discussed in full.
Contact.mapConsentNote: Loads Google Maps. Google may set cookies.
Contact.parking: Kosti Palama municipal car park, opposite the clinic.

Booking.title: Book a consultation
Booking.lead: Choose a time that suits you. Your consultation takes place at the clinic in Cyprus.
Booking.placeholder: Online booking is being set up. In the meantime, contact the clinic to arrange your consultation.
Booking.note: No medical history is collected here — only what we need to arrange your visit. Every procedure requires an in-person consultation and carries risks and recovery time.

BookingWizard.title: Book an appointment
BookingWizard.intro: A couple of quick questions, so we book the right appointment.
BookingWizard.modeTitle: What would you like to book?
BookingWizard.modeOnlineDesc: A video consultation — for patients outside the Cyprus GHS (GeSY).
BookingWizard.gesyTitle: Are you registered with the Cyprus GHS (GeSY)?
BookingWizard.gesyNo: No — I live abroad or am a foreign national
BookingWizard.gesyBlockTitle: Online consultation isn't available through GeSY
BookingWizard.gesyBlockBody: Online consultations can't be billed through GeSY, so they're only available to patients outside it. Please book an in-person appointment, or call us.
BookingWizard.reasonTitle: What is the reason for your visit?
BookingWizard.callBody: For anything outside these categories, our secretariat will help you find the right appointment.
BookingWizard.onlineArrangeBody: Please call us to schedule your online consultation.

Consent.title: Cookie choices
Consent.message: We use cookies for analytics and marketing. Accept or reject non-essential cookies.

Procedure.indexIntro: Nose and sinus procedures by Dr Paris Papakostas in Nicosia, Cyprus. Each requires an in-person consultation; all surgery carries risks and recovery time.
Procedure.risksNote: A consultation is required before any procedure. This is surgery: it carries risks and needs recovery time. Results vary between patients.
Procedure.beforeAfterNote: Shown only with patient consent. Results vary. Every procedure carries risks. Not shown on the German site.
Procedure.ctaTitle: Discuss this procedure with Dr Papakostas

Procedure.step1Body: Every procedure begins with an in-person consultation, where your options, the risks and the recovery are explained in full.
Procedure.step2Body: The procedure is carried out in Cyprus, at <clinic>The Surgery Center 3i</clinic>, planned around your anatomy and your goals.
